Claude Instructions

Source: CLAUDE.md

Read AGENTS.md first.

AGENTS.md is the canonical repository instruction file for coding agents in this repo. The package design standards, interface rules, and validation contract are defined there and in the linked files under markdown_notes/design/; the compact live roadmap is markdown_notes/rdistnn_roadmap.md, and completed plans are archived under markdown_notes/archive/.

Before changing code, especially in exported functions or shared helpers, follow AGENTS.md and its required read order.

For mathematical derivations, symbolic checks, or finite combinatorial verification, Mathematica / Wolfram Language is available through wolframscript and should be used when helpful; record nontrivial conclusions in code, tests, or design notes rather than relying on an ephemeral session.

Local CLI tooling on the parent Windows workspace was verified on 2026-05-06: rg, rga, and fd for search/discovery; jq, yq, and duckdb for structured data; pdfinfo, pdftotext, pdftoppm, pdffonts, qpdf, gswin64c, magick, tesseract, ocrmypdf, and exiftool for PDF/OCR/image work; and Rscript, pandoc, latexmk, lualatex, gh, gcc, g++, make, cmake, and wolframscript for package/document/build work. Use magick, not Windows convert.exe. Tesseract has eng and osd; use ocrmypdf --skip-text --deskew --rotate-pages for scanned PDFs and pdftotext -layout for searchable PDFs. Code-quality tools now available include actionlint, shellcheck, shfmt, pre-commit, and ruff. pip, pip3, pre-commit, ruff, and exiftool are exposed through shims in C:\Users\jakob\.local\bin.

Developed by Jakob Juergens.
